turns.user_message: And somewhere we can all eat together after?
turns.agent_response:
For a meal the kids will talk about the whole way home, Hash House A Go Go is the place to be because the portions are legendary — it opens at 8:00 AM and serves its famous "twisted farm food" until 2:00 PM. The pancakes are literally larger than the plates, and the high-energy atmosphere in the Casino of the Earth is perfect for regrouping with an 8 and 12-year-old. 

It operates on a first-come, first-served basis, so I'd recommend heading over shortly after they open to beat the midday rush. Please keep in mind that hours and pricing can vary, so you may want to confirm the current schedule with the property upon arrival. After such a massive breakfast, the Cyber Quest arcade is right nearby if the kids have any energy left to burn.
